The following forum message was posted by tfry at http://sourceforge.net/projects/rkward/forums/forum/165574/topic/4789779:

[quote]should I just wait for a newer version?[/quote]

no, 0.5.7 should be fine. However it has to be compiled against R 2.14 in order
to work with R 2.14.0. I believe the problem is that you are using our daily
builds, and we do not currently offer those in a variant that is built against
the CRAN version of R (I'll have to check, whether it would be possible to add
this), but you have installed R 2.14 from CRAN. For the moment, your options
are:

- upgrade to a series of Ubuntu that already ships R 2.14.0 by default
- compile RKWard from sources instead of using the daily builds. On Ubuntu it's
not too hard: http://p.sf.net/rkward/svn
- use our "official stable" PPA. We offer this in a variant for the CRAN version
of R (https://launchpad.net/~rkward-devel/+archive/rkward-stable-cran).

Regards
Thomas

messages.body_plain:
Hi,

On Thursday 03 November 2011, Matthieu Stigler wrote:
> short question: having already the other PPA, I guess I need to remove it?
> I saw there are two possibilities, remove just ppa or package also?

I'm not sure, how apt will handle this situation, i.e. whether it will install 
the package from the new PPA, automatically. To make sure it does, 

> sudoppa-purgeppa:<nom_du_d?p?t>

is probably a good idea. Alternatively,

  sudo apt-get remove rkward
  sudo apt-add-repository --remove  ppa:<old repo>
  sudo apt-add-repository ppa:<new repo>
  sudo apt-get update
  sudo apt-get install rkward

(rkward is the only package in our PPA, though, so this should not make a 
difference).

Regards
Thomas

Hi, 

Apologies for the straightforward question, but I can't find an answer in the
documentation.

How do insert a TAB character at the start of a line? The TAB key (and ctrl-I)
insert 2 spaces rather than a tab when at the beginning of a line, but a TAB
in the middle or at the end. Is there any way of making the TAB key behave like
this at the start?

Also, can I change the formatting view, so the tab identifier (>>) is more
obvious?

Thanks

messages.subject: [rkward-users] [Help] RE: Inserting TAB in RKward
messages.body_plain:
The following forum message was posted by tfry at http://sourceforge.net/projects/rkward/forums/forum/165574/topic/4800433:

Hi,

[quote]How do insert a TAB character at the start of a line? The TAB key (and
ctrl-I) insert 2 spaces rather than a tab when at the beginning of a line, but
a TAB in the middle or at the end. Is there any way of making the TAB key behave
like this at the start?[/quote]

I agree the configuration options on this are pretty confusing. Do this: Open
a script window, go to Settings->Configure Editor->Editing->Indentation. You
will want to set your indentation mode to either "Tabulators" (recommended)
or "Tabulators and Spaces". For the latter option, make sure that your setting
for indentation width equals the tab width (e.g. set both to 8 characters).

[quote]Also, can I change the formatting view, so the tab identifier (>>) is
more obvious?[/quote]

In the configuration dialog, go to "Fonts & Colors". You can adjust the color
of the "Tab and space markers", there.

Regards
Thomas
